messages:
Leah - People Ops: Hey team — planning a small recognition run: "Core Values" enamel badges (lapel pins) for folks who got spot awards this quarter. Need help with ordering + engraving + shipping. Goal: mail before Q2 all-hands. :tada:
Kat - People Ops: Love this. Do we have a vendor in mind or should Procurement source?
Marco - Procurement: I can kick off vendor quotes. Estimated lead time for engraved enamel pins is 2–3 weeks after proof sign-off. Budget estimate: $7–12 per pin depending on quantity.
Aisha - HRBP: We need an approval path for manager nominations and an audit trail for who gets a pin. Can we reuse the spot-award list?
Leah - People Ops: Yes reuse spot-award list as canonical. Will export manager notes into the vendor order table. Need managers to confirm shipping addresses by EOD Mon 2024-04-22.
Jordan - Eng Manager: Can you share the list? I'll verify my team.
Leah - People Ops: Sharing spreadsheet now: https://tiny.redwood/kv-badges (please don't publicize)
Leah - People Ops: Spreadsheet columns: `employee name | manager | office | postal address | pin color | approval status`
Kat - People Ops: Quick ask — remote folks: do we include a little handwritten note? I can recruit volunteers to write them. :heart:
Maya - Talent: I can add 4 volunteers from Talent for writing.
Dinesh - Office Ops: For SF/NYC offices I can coordinate a local drop box and distribute in clusters to avoid individual shipping where possible.
Marco - Procurement: I'll gather 3 vendor quotes and post a comparison doc by Thu. Will include lead times and engraving options (name engraving vs blank).
Aisha - HRBP: Engraved names might have privacy considerations — confirm with legal? Also longer lead times.
Leah - People Ops: Good point. Maybe do engraved role or "Core Value: [value]" instead of full name. Leaning to a small engraved role/title line only.
Jordan - Eng Manager: Fine with title or core value — avoids typos and privacy noise.
ops-bot: Reminder — procurement approvals must be submitted before the end of the month to meet finance cutoffs.
Kat - People Ops: Shipping cutoff for bulk office drop: 2024-05-10. Postal shipments cutoff: 2024-05-01 (to avoid delays).
Leah - People Ops: Action items: 1) Marco: vendor quotes by Thu. 2) Managers: confirm addresses in sheet by Mon 4/22. 3) Kat & Maya: volunteer note-writers and plan for office drops. 4) Dinesh: local drop logistics.
Marco - Procurement: Got it. I'll ping here when quotes uploaded.
Maya - Talent: I'll DM volunteers and add a tab in the sheet for note assignments.
Kat - People Ops: If anyone wants to help with label printing or stuffing envelopes next week, put your name in the 'volunteer' tab. We can do two short shifts late afternoons. :coffee:
Jordan - Eng Manager: I'll confirm addresses for my team tonight.
Leah - People Ops: Thanks everyone — will post updates in this thread. If any manager needs exceptions for PO boxes, flag them here.
Aisha - HRBP: One more — can we include a small digital certificate email for folks who prefer not to receive mail?
Leah - People Ops: Yes, we'll add a digital certificate option column in the sheet.
Kat - People Ops: Approved :white_check_mark: — excited for this one!
Marco - Procurement: Uploaded vendor shortlist: https://tiny.redwood/kv-badges-quotes — includes sample proofs.
Leah - People Ops: Proof review scheduled Fri 10am PT. RSVP in calendar invite.
Dinesh - Office Ops: Noted. Will set up drop boxes in SF lobby and NYC mailroom the week of 5/6.
Leah - People Ops: Last note — keeping awards modest and inclusive. If anyone has cultural/accessibility considerations for physical pins, DM me.
Kat - People Ops: Thanks all. Closing for now; will reopen if timeline shifts. :sparkles:
